artworks.title: Menelaus and Helen
artworks.description: Mengs' reunion of the Spartan king and his queen — the homecoming Menelaus reached only after the Egyptian detour and Proteus' prophecy.

artworks.title: Telemachus and the Nymphs of Calypso
artworks.description: Styka's Odyssey scene — the voyage that brought Telemachus to Menelaus' hall in Sparta, where the Egypt tale was told again.

artworks.title: The Colossi of Memnon
artworks.description: Roberts' Egyptian landscape — the land of the Nile where Menelaus wandered eight years before Pharos and the binding of Proteus.
